title: Regular Installment Figure for TRICARE Prime Drafts on File
content:
For a draft through the payment method on file of a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment, a regular installment is set by the installment whose coverage period begins latest.

| Installment whose coverage period begins latest | A regular installment for a draft |
|---|---|
| a monthly installment | one twelfth of the annual fee of the enrollment's fee arrangement (divided by 12), rounded to the cent |
| a quarterly installment | one quarter of that fee (divided by 4), rounded to the cent |
| otherwise | the whole annual fee |

**Hypothetical values**, TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A family arrangement (annual fee 780.24): 65.02 where the latest-beginning installment is monthly, 195.06 where it is quarterly, 780.24 otherwise.
